name: Getting Rest
overview: Scripture reveals that true rest is a divine gift rooted in trusting God’s care and provision. The command to keep the Sabbath holy (Exodus 20:8) underscores the importance of setting aside time for spiritual renewal. The Psalms portray rest as peaceful security granted by the Lord, who leads His people to tranquility and safety (Psalms 4:8; 23:2). God’s love provides sweet sleep even amid life’s labors, reminding believers that human effort alone cannot secure rest (Psalms 127:2; Proverbs 3:24; Ecclesiastes 5:12).
